scripts.build: npm run build:themes && npm run build:mcp && vite build && vite build --ssr resources/js/ssr.tsx --outDir bootstrap/ssr
scripts.format:haxe: haxelib run formatter -s src -s tests/haxe -s tests/plugins -s examples/plugins
scripts.format:web: prettier --write mcp resources/js resources/css resources/lang resources/themes examples tests/plugins scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs vite.config.ts
scripts.format:python: UV_TOOL_DIR=.tools/uv-tools uv --cache-dir .tools/uv-cache tool run --from black==26.10.1 black scripts tests
scripts.format: npm run format:haxe && npm run format:web && npm run format:python
scripts.format:check: haxelib run formatter -s src -s tests/haxe -s tests/plugins -s examples/plugins --check && prettier --check mcp resources/js resources/css resources/lang resources/themes examples tests/plugins scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs vite.config.ts && UV_TOOL_DIR=.tools/uv-tools uv --offline --cache-dir .tools/uv-cache tool run --from black==26.10.1 black --check scripts tests
